description: Mend Renovate GitHub App config. Rules are evaluated top to bottom and later rules win.
Policy overview lives in AGENTS.md (Renovate section). Merging updates git and Argo auto-syncs every Application, so no manual sync is needed.

customManagers.description: Images in versions.ts. check-versions.ts reads this regex, so keep it as the single source of truth.
Helm charts from a classic chart repository (kind: repo) in versions.ts.
Helm charts from an OCI registry (kind: oci) in versions.ts; looked up as registry tags. Chart tags are semver, some with a v prefix.

packageRules.description: Age: minimumReleaseAge 7d is set globally and applies to every update.

GHCR, Quay and dragonflydb.io expose no trusted release timestamp, so with the default timestamp-required their updates would sit in Pending Status Checks forever. Raise them without an age check; the 7d age only applies to Docker Hub, Helm repo and npm updates.
Short PR titles: the default topics append 'Docker tag' or 'helm values', which pushes long OCI names past 80 characters.
Auto-merge patches, digests, and minors for every dependency type; the verify check catches npm and render breakage.
Denylist, never auto-merge (minors included): images and OCI charts. A kube-vip rollout moves the API and ingress VIPs.
Denylist, never auto-merge: a chart bump can upgrade the VictoriaMetrics operator and its CRDs, which need a manual look.
immich chart and server image move together.
The typetype images are released together.
The bun image, bun-types and the CI setup-bun version track the same runtime.
linuxserver also publishes Ubuntu-style tags such as 20.04.1 that look like a major update; only accept plain x.y.z app versions.
Disabled: floating or compound tags Renovate cannot order, and Postgres majors (see docs/postgres-migration.md).
Postgres major upgrades are manual migrations.
